message.content:
You are implementing Task 8.2: Audio Integration for the Vibe Voyager game.

## Context
This is a Next.js 15 app with React 19, using Motion (import from `motion/react`), Tailwind CSS v4, Howler.js for audio. The audio system already exists — you just need to wire `playSFX` calls into existing components.

## Audio System (already built)
The `useAudio()` hook from `@/components/audio/AudioManager` provides:
- `playSFX(name)` — plays a sound effect
- Available SFX names: 'click', 'hover', 'warp', 'mission-complete', 'dialogue-blip', 'success', 'error', 'rank-up'
- Audio files already exist at `public/audio/sfx/*.mp3`
- `muted` and `toggleMute` also available

## YOUR FILES (only touch these — other agents own other files)
1. MODIFY: `components/ui/Button.tsx` — Add click SFX
2. MODIFY: `components/game/DialogueSystem.tsx` — Add dialogue-blip on text reveal, success/error on choices
3. MODIFY: `components/game/MissionBriefing.tsx` — Add warp SFX on begin
4. MODIFY: `components/game/MissionDebrief.tsx` — Add mission-complete SFX on mount
5. MODIFY: `components/games/PromptDuel.tsx` — Add success/error SFX on scoring
6. MODIFY: `components/games/Architect.tsx` — Add click/success/error SFX
7. MODIFY: `components/games/Connect.tsx` — Add click/success/error SFX
8. MODIFY: `components/games/Debug.tsx` — Add click/success/error SFX
9. MODIFY: `components/games/Command.tsx` — Add click/success/error SFX

## DO NOT TOUCH these files (owned by other agents):
- app/layout.tsx
- app/page.tsx
- app/starmap/page.tsx
- app/cockpit/page.tsx
- app/create/page.tsx
- app/crew/page.tsx
- app/inventory/page.tsx
- app/academy/*
- components/ui/GlassPanel.tsx
- components/ui/PageTransition.tsx
- components/game/NavBar.tsx
- components/game/StarMap.tsx
- Any files in public/images/

## Current Button.tsx:
```tsx
'use client'

import { motion } from 'motion/react'
import { clsx } from 'clsx'

interface ButtonProps {
  children: React.ReactNode
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'danger' | 'success' | 'ghost'
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
  disabled?: boolean
  onClick?: () => void
  className?: string
  type?: 'button' | 'submit'
}

// ... variant and size styles ...

export function Button({ children, variant = 'primary', size = 'md', disabled, onClick, className, type = 'button' }: ButtonProps) {
  return (
    <motion.button
      type={type}
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      className={clsx(
        'font-display uppercase tracking-wider border rounded-xl backdrop-blur-sm transition-colors',
        'focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-nebula/50',
        variantStyles[variant],
        sizeStyles[size],
        disabled && 'opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed',
        className
      )}
      whileHover={disabled ? undefined : { scale: 1.03 }}
      whileTap={disabled ? undefined : { scale: 0.97 }}
      transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 400, damping: 25 }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.button>
  )
}
```

## Implementation Requirements

### Button.tsx
- Import `useAudio` from `@/components/audio/AudioManager`
- Add click SFX: wrap onClick to call `playSFX('click')` before the original onClick
- Only play if not disabled
- Keep the existing component API exactly the same

### DialogueSystem.tsx
- Import `useAudio`
- Play `dialogue-blip` once when typewriter text starts (not on every character)
- Play `success` when user picks a correct choice
- Play `error` when user picks an incorrect choice

### MissionBriefing.tsx
- Import `useAudio`
- Play `warp` SFX when the "Begin Mission" button is clicked (before calling onBegin)

### MissionDebrief.tsx
- Import `useAudio`
- Play `mission-complete` SFX on component mount (useEffect with empty deps)

### Mini-games (PromptDuel, Architect, Connect, Debug, Command)
- Import `useAudio` in each
- Play `click` on user interactions (placing items, clicking lines, etc.)
- Play `success` when challenge is completed with score >= 70
- Play `error` when challenge is completed with score < 70
- Keep it simple — 2-3 playSFX calls per component max

## Rules
- Read each file FIRST before modifying
- Use `clsx` for classNames (NOT cn)
- Motion: import from `motion/react`
- Do NOT use `\!` in TSX
- Do NOT change component APIs or prop interfaces
- Keep changes minimal — just add the SFX hooks
